@graph.headline: ACOS Quick Start: Zero to Production in 10 Minutes
@graph.description: Deploy Agentic Creator OS from zero to production in under an hour: prerequisites, repository setup, MCP configuration, and initial deployment.
@graph.keywords: acos quick start, agentic creator os tutorial, claude code setup, ai productivity setup, acos installation
@graph.abstract: This zero-to-production quickstart walks through configuring Agentic Creator OS from scratch. In under an hour, developers set up environment variables, connect essential MCP servers, and run their first orchestrated multi-agent workflow.

mainEntity.name: What are the prerequisites for running ACOS?

acceptedAnswer.text: Node.js v20+, an Anthropic API key, Git, and a modern terminal environment (PowerShell, Bash, or Zsh).

mainEntity.name: How long does the initial setup take?

acceptedAnswer.text: The foundational quickstart can be completed and verified in approximately 30 to 45 minutes.

mainEntity.name: Which MCP servers should I configure first?

acceptedAnswer.text: Start with the Memory server for persistent context and the Filesystem server for local project navigation.

mainEntity.name: Does ACOS require paid software subscriptions?

acceptedAnswer.text: ACOS itself is open-source. You only pay for model API consumption through your own Anthropic or OpenAI API keys.

mainEntity.name: How do I test that ACOS is operating correctly?

acceptedAnswer.text: Execute the built-in smoke test suite to verify agent registration, tool calling, and quality gate scripts.
